tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every card. A faint lavender, never pure white, so white cards lift off it without heavy shadows.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, bottom nav, side rail.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inset areas inside a card: search field, time pills, icon buttons, the streak panel.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: The one highlighted card on a screen: active lesson, AI hero banner. A light lavender; text on it uses ink / ink-muted.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline card borders and list dividers (1px).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Unfilled segments of progress bars, dashed timeline guides, empty streak rings. Never text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on bg, surface and the tinted surfaces.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, times, lesson counts, inactive nav labels. ≥4.5:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Icons and placeholder glyphs only (≥3:1). Not for running text.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand purple #917EFF — bright lavender. The brand's face: logo tile background in artwork, progress segments, active-tab bar, selected-option border, the AI orb, cover blocks. NOT for fills that carry text — those use primary-strong (white on #917EFF is only 3.2:1).

tokens.name: primary-strong
tokens.usage: One step deeper than primary, for every purple fill that carries text or an icon: primary button, swipe CTA, centre FAB, selected date, current-time pill, logo, purple stat icon, selected quiz key, dark icon button. White text on it reads 4.7:1.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-strong — white in both themes.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind purple icons, soft buttons, default avatars.

tokens.name: primary-ink
tokens.usage: Purple text on surface, primary-soft or surface-tint: the app name in the greeting, soft buttons, ghost links.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Brand blue #6B9CFF — bright cornflower, the AI and information colour in its light uses: AI chip tint partner, focus rings, the class dot in the date strip, the hero spark, the AI orb. Fills that carry text use blue-strong.

tokens.name: blue-strong
tokens.usage: One step deeper than blue, for blue fills that carry text or an icon: Ask AI button, send button, blue stat icon. White text on it reads 4.6:1.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text and icons on blue-strong — white in both themes.

tokens.name: blue-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind AI chips and AI skill tiles.

tokens.name: blue-ink
tokens.usage: Blue text on surface or blue-soft: AI keywords, 'AI Sensei'.

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: A small warm spark beside the cool brand colours: streak flame, XP, the ring around an avatar on a streak. Fills only, never a button.

tokens.name: peach-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind XP, ranking and achievement icons.

tokens.name: peach-ink
tokens.usage: Warm text: +XP, ranking label.

tokens.name: sakura
tokens.usage: Character colour — Pyon's sakura hanten and the petals of celebration moments (goal complete, streak milestones). Fills only, never UI text or a button. Paler and softer than skill-kanji (#FF6FB5), which stays the Kanji skill colour.

tokens.name: sakura-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind Pyon in celebration screens and sakura badges.

tokens.name: sakura-ink
tokens.usage: Text on sakura-soft: celebration titles' accents, 'ぴょん'.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Done / correct fills, a vivid fresh green (#28D873) as lively as the brand purple and blue: streak check dots, today's streak day, the correct option's key and the feedback icon. Text and checkmarks on it use on-green (dark), never white.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text and checkmarks on green — deep forest ink in both themes.

tokens.name: green-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the correct option only. The feedback sheet stays neutral (surface) so the purple Continue button is its only fill.

tokens.name: green-ink
tokens.usage: Success text: 'Đúng rồi!', completed labels.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Wrong answer, 'no class' gap line, notification dot.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the wrong option only; the feedback sheet stays neutral.

tokens.name: skill-vocab
tokens.usage: Skill colour — Từ vựng (vocabulary), a clear sky blue, lighter and greener than brand blue. Icon strokes, filled progress segments, schedule chips.

tokens.name: skill-vocab-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind vocabulary tiles and chips.

tokens.name: skill-vocab-ink
tokens.usage: Vocabulary text on its soft tint.

tokens.name: skill-grammar
tokens.usage: Skill colour — Ngữ pháp (grammar), a bright periwinkle between brand purple and blue.

tokens.name: skill-grammar-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind grammar tiles and chips.

tokens.name: skill-grammar-ink
tokens.usage: Grammar text on its soft tint.

tokens.name: skill-kanji
tokens.usage: Skill colour — Kanji & đọc hiểu (reading), a bright rose.

tokens.name: skill-kanji-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind kanji tiles and chips.

tokens.name: skill-kanji-ink
tokens.usage: Kanji text on its soft tint.

tokens.name: skill-speaking
tokens.usage: Skill colour — Nghe & nói (listening, speaking), a fresh mint.

tokens.name: skill-speaking-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind speaking tiles and chips.

tokens.name: skill-speaking-ink
tokens.usage: Speaking text on its soft tint.

families.sans: "Plus Jakarta Sans", "Noto Sans JP", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.jp: "Noto Sans JP", "Hiragino Sans", "Yu Gothic", "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Big numbers: progress %, streak days, stat cards. Tabular figures.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Luyện 5 phút mỗi ngày để giữ chuỗi.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Times, lesson counts, subtitles in ink-muted.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Nav labels, weekday letters, avatar overflow counts.

styles.name: jp-hero
styles.usage: Flashcard face: the kana or kanji being studied.

styles.name: jp-body
styles.sample: わたしは がくせい です。
styles.usage: Example sentences. Taller leading leaves room for furigana.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between avatars, small stacks, chip rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between list items; icon tile to text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phone; screen side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on tablet; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of screen to greeting; hero spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Icon tiles, small chips, schedule events.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, list items, date cells.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero cards, bottom sheets, phone frame corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, pills, progress segments, avatars, icon buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards on bg. Soft and wide; the hairline border does the edge.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Floating: bottom nav, popovers, the selected date cell.

tokens.name: shadow-fab
tokens.usage: The centre FAB and the selected date only — a soft purple glow, not grey.
